Title: LSJ question - torpor and daring the dawn

Messages.Author: Draxx
Messages.Body:
Hello,

The followings happened during one of my recent games and the opinions
were completely different about the outcome of the action.

I try to describe, what happened.

Haakon Mortensen is in torpor untapped. He plays regeneration at
superior. Kyj Dansky with +1 intercept is ready to block Haakon.
Suddenly Haakon plays a daring the dawn making this action
unblockable.

I think right after this action Haakon burns like a torch since he had
been in torpor before the action resolved. Unfortunately some players
not to mention the controller of Haakon strongly disagreed on this.

Can you advise me if A vampire can survive such an action?

Thanks in advance!

Draxx

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Draxx wrote:
> Haakon Mortensen is in torpor untapped. He plays regeneration at
> superior. Kyj Dansky with +1 intercept is ready to block Haakon.
> Suddenly Haakon plays a daring the dawn making this action
> unblockable.
>
> I think right after this action Haakon burns like a torch since he had
> been in torpor before the action resolved. Unfortunately some players
> not to mention the controller of Haakon strongly disagreed on this.
>
> Can you advise me if A vampire can survive such an action?

He survives.

Assuming he plays both Regeneration and Daring the Dawn at superior,
he will gain 5 blood from Regen and then take 1 aggravated damage from
DtD, for which he will have to burn 1 blood to prevent his destruction
(since he's "wounded"), so he nets 4 blood (assuming none of the 5
blood drained off - that is, assuming he has the capacity to hold the
five extra blood that he gained from the Regen).
